scenes.text: So can Claude replace it? I gave it one written spec, and the spec is free. Here's the board it built. One square per project, every week.
When an owner misses a week, it says No update, instead of quietly keeping last week's green.
And the weekly report writes itself from the saved updates, with Blocked first.
All twenty-eight checks passed. But sign-in, real email and hosting were never tested, so check those first.
